_about: Public-domain A. P. Stanley (Arthur Penrhyn Stanley, 1815-1881, Broad Church, Dean of Westminster) for the Word Hoard: 18 books from Internet Archive scans, 1847-1882, among them Sermons and Essays on the Apostolical Age (1847), his Corinthians (1855), Lectures on the History of the Eastern Church (1861), the three series of Lectures on the History of the Jewish Church (1863-1876) and Christian Institutions (1881). Raw OCR. His Life of Arnold and his travel and abbey histories are left as alternates. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 23 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
